newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank's Vit sees no drama in crown rate-CTK.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank's Vit sees no drama in crown rate-CTK.

text.p: A vice-governor of the Czech central bank (CNB) on Thursday said he did not expect a dramatic change in the Czech crown's exchange rate in the near future, the local CTK news agency reported.

It quoted vice-governor Jan Vit as saying after a meeting with the parliamentary banking committee that it was still to soon to predict what effect recent devastating floods in the eastern part of the country would have on the crown.
"I wouldn't expect dramatic effects (on the crown). Certainly the crown will move in a clear market fluctuation
